'''Lilyland''' is an independent city-state of the nation of [[Rinascita]]. Like [[Ragunna]] and [[Septimont]], it is made out of islands deep in the Stormy Sea and shares their common history, being settled by ocean wanderers who came to the Rinascitan archipelago under the guidance and protection of the [[Sentinel]] [[Imperator]].  

Lilyland is known for hosting the "Lilyland Fashion Week"<ref>[[Roboan]]</ref> and having a large stage surrounded by fields of flowers, with the audience throwing petals as applause.<ref>[[Emilia]]</ref> The beauty industry in general is important in Lilyland, with products such as Upala Perfume and Efreeta Hair Conditioner, and Huanglong's rising fashion star [[Linglong]] has presented work at the fashion week.<ref>Zani's [[Downtown Repose]] outfit hides a lot of information about Lilyland hidden in an idle animation. The decoded text can be found [https://x.com/bukibread/status/2082844362476757052 here] or [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F0laomKYMDg here].</ref> 

According to one of the movies Lucilla asks you to recommend for her in the Startorch Academy Anecdotes, Lilyland have functioning train lines.

The Fisher family is highly important in Lilyland, akin to the [[Montelli Family|Montellis]] or [[Fisalia Family|Fisalias]] of Ragunna. They have commercial and legal ties with the Montellis, and run the largest art museum in the city-state. They also run a Shopping Festival.

The [[Troupe of Fools]] often visits it and refers to Lilyland as a "Sea of Flowers".<ref>[[Claudio]]</ref> Recently, during their tour, [[Aalto]] and [[Brant]] apprehended ticket scalpers in what the [[Pioneer Podcast]] dubbed the "Lilyland Incident".<ref>{{Quest|Flowing Starlight in the Iris}}</ref>

Dr. [[Scott Rabelle]] left his home country, the [[New Federation]], to settle in Lilyland later in his life.<ref>[[Luncius]]</ref> 
[[Denia]]'s Startorch Academy ID contains a possibly false address in Lilyland, the Happy Family Dessert Shop.

== Trivia ==
*Lilyland is probably named after the city of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Florence Florence], given it is nicknamed "''la città gigliata"'' (the Lily town). It is also worth noting that Italy's national flower is the white lily, also known as the Madonna lily (''Lilium candidum''), which symbolizes purity and virtue. It is deeply rooted in Italian heritage and often associated with the Virgin Mary.
